sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: In this paper we study a class of Riemann-Hilbert problems arising naturally in Donaldson-Thomas theory. They involve maps from the complex plane to an algebraic torus, with prescribed discontinuities along a collection of rays, and are closely related to the Riemann-Hilbert problems considered by Gaiotto, Moore and Neitzke \cite{GMN1}; in physical terms we are considering the conformal limit of their story. sections.title: Plan of the paper

sections.title: Two classes of examples
sections.extract: There are two important classes of examples of BPS structures where we can say something about solutions to the Riemann-Hilbert problem. Both are also of interest in theoretical physics. They are treated a little more thoroughly in Sections \ref{gw} and \ref{in}, but there are many unanswered questions which we leave for future research.
